  "on_screen_text": "GitHub - microsoft/hve-core | github.com/microsoft/hve-core | view all files | README Code of conduct Contributing MIT license Security | title: HVE Core | description: Hypervelocity Engineering prompt library for GitH... | author: Microsoft | ms.date: 2026-08-13 | ms.topic: overview | keywords: hypervelocity engineering, prompt engineeri... | estimated_reading_time: 3 | Hypervelocity Engineering (HVE) Core | badges: Stater Release Preparation, CodeQL Security Analysis, openssf scorecard, openssf best practices | HVE Core helps teams ship faster with GitHub Copilot by combining specialized agents, reusable prompts, coding instructions, and validated skills into one workflow system. | Use HVE Core when you want AI-assisted work to be repeatable, standards-aligned, and scalable across individuals and teams. HVE Core provides structured AI workflow building blocks: | Agents for specialized tasks such as research, planning, implementation, and review | Prompts for repeatable workflow entry points | Instructions that apply coding standards automatically | Skills that add reusable tool capabilities | Caution: HVE Core is a highly opinionated, rapidly evolving agentic SDLC framework. It is best treated as a source of patterns and learning rather than a stable platform, foundation, or production dependency. Workflows, interfaces, architecture, and recommended practices may change substantially, including in ways that are not backward compatible, as the technology landscape evolves. Evaluate all materials for your own requirements and risk tolerance. The HVE Builder skill (use with /hve-builder) and GitHub Copilot can help you adapt or copy relevant patterns into an agentic SDLC that you own and maintain independently. To build an independent",
  "key_claims": [
    "HVE Core is a project kit that gives AI assistants specific job roles to ship work",
    "Microsoft built HVE Core as an open source collection",
    "It solves the problem of generic AI advice via pre-written instructions, prompts, and specialized agents",
    "Covers tasks from security reviews to accessibility checks and sprint planning",
    "Can be dropped into an existing GitHub Copilot setup to upgrade workflow",
    "Turns a coding assistant into a disciplined team that follows company standards without re-teaching it daily",
